framework: O*NET Work Values (six), measured through story dilemmas
role: secondary: explanations, tie-breaks between close paths (fit difference < 0.02, see scoring.json tie_break), career suggestions inside a stream; never part of the fit score. With only 4-6 dilemmas these are shown as 'what you chose in the dilemmas', not as a measured trait.

values.name: Achievement
values.plain: Using your strengths and seeing results

values.name: Independence
values.plain: Working your own way, making your own decisions

values.name: Recognition
values.plain: Respect, status and chances to move up

values.name: Relationships
values.plain: Helping people and working with people you like

values.name: Support
values.plain: A fair, supportive place to work

values.name: Working Conditions
values.plain: Security, good pay and comfortable conditions

dilemmas.story: Paid weekend shifts at the shop, or helping at Dr Amna's clinic for free?
Lead the robotics team on stage, or build your own side project quietly?
Join the friendly club with a patient coach, or the tough one that wins every year?
Push the stall to beat last year's sales, or give your best spot to a friend who needs it?
Freelance editing with no fixed pay, or a steady monthly job at your cousin's office?
Your name on the winning poster, or the whole team thanked equally?

scoring: Bradley-Terry scores from the pairwise picks; shown as words, never numbers
